specification: Three trained datasets with more than 3,000 training questions each, plus an extrapolation set
evidence: Training questions: RACE++ 100,568, ARC 3,358, MATH 6,748. Extrapolation set: ScienceQA with 2,224 test questions.

specification: At least four model families and three output types, all on identical splits
evidence: Families: classical, feature, floor, open LLM, recurrent, transformer. Output types: classification, ordinal, regression. All 55 runs with saved predictions hold the same question ids for each dataset and split.

specification: Spearman at least 0.79 on the full training set
evidence: deberta-v3, CORN head is the best setting on dev (QWK 0.700), trained on the full training set. Spearman on test: 0.687, against 0.79. The published 0.79 was reached with the reading passage in the input; our input holds the question and its options only.

specification: Mean Spearman at least 0.50 over 3 seeds, for the setting with the best mean QWK on dev
evidence: deberta-v3, CORN head has the best mean QWK on dev among the settings with 3 seeds (0.657). Mean Spearman on test over 3 seeds: 0.630, against 0.50.

specification: The best transformer beats the best classical model on QWK, 95% bootstrap interval above zero
evidence: math-deberta-v3-corn-s0 (QWK 0.567) against math-tfidf_logreg-none-cv5-s0 (QWK 0.507) on test. Difference 0.061, 95% bootstrap interval 0.040 to 0.082, 2,000 resamples of the same questions.

specification: An ordinal head has lower Balanced DRPS than cross-entropy on at least two of three datasets, same backbone
evidence: CORN has the lower Balanced DRPS on test: bilstm 3 of 3 datasets, deberta-v3 3 of 3 datasets, distilbert 0 of 3 datasets. Met with bilstm and deberta-v3, not with distilbert.

specification: ARC, same setting as R3: standard deviation of Spearman over 3 seeds at most 0.05
evidence: deberta-v3, CORN head, 3 seeds. Standard deviation of Spearman on test: 0.004, against 0.05. Published BERT on the balanced training set: 0.139.

specification: Every fine-tune at most 1 GPU-hour, the whole project at most 20 GPU-hours
evidence: 28 fine-tunes. The longest is math-bilstm-ce-s0 at 0.19 hours, against 1. Whole project: 0.89 GPU-hours, against 20. Details in results/tables/efficiency.md.

specification: Demo: at most 1 second per question on a CPU, DistilBERT, timed over 100 items
evidence: distilbert, one question at a time on a CPU: 0.028 to 0.033 seconds over 4 saved models, against 1. The slowest measurement decides.

specification: Every run starts from one config; every table and figure is rebuilt from the results store with one command
evidence: 55 of 55 runs carry the config they started from. The 9 leaderboard tables rebuilt from the store are identical to the files in results/tables/. One command each: `python -m levellens.results`, `python -m levellens.figures`.
